items.text: Please join me in prayer for Leader @SteveScalise’s speedy and full recovery. Steve is a fighter and an inspiration, and I will support him every step of the way as he begins treatment.

Yesterday, Mountain Youth Academy, a trauma-based residential treatment facility located in Mountain City, announced the opening of its new facility in Johnson County. Mountain Youth Academy exclusively treats children and adolescents, both boys and girls ages 5–17. Their trauma treatment offers individual, group and family trauma therapy as well as other treatment methodologies to help youth deal with traumas they have experienced.

In Erwin today, I had the opportunity to visit Lee Brown and the dedicated team at Erwin Utilities at their wastewater treatment plant, which was destroyed by flood waters.
